name: German office intent blind holdout v1
description: 90 synthetic German questions, 10 per intent, written in one pass by an independent agent that knew only the intent definitions: not the code, the prompts, the training data, the development holdout or its errors. Used only to accept or reject trained adapters, never for prompt or training decisions. No real persons, companies or customer data.
